text: cortex-dsh-web-command 是 DSH Web 命令插件，注册 /cortex 以连接本机 CORTEX 任务池。用户可查询状态、将 manifest 任务加入队列或请求恢复，并收到简短结果。命令由 DSH 主机进程使用 CORTEX_API_TOKEN 认证，适合从 DSH Web 管理本机任务池；需要本机 API 和令牌。

cortex-dsh-web-command adds /cortex to DSH Web and connects it to a local CORTEX task pool. Users can check status, enqueue a manifest task, or request recovery and receive a short result. The DSH host authenticates with CORTEX_API_TOKEN. A local API and token are required.
想在 DSH Web 聊天里查看本机 CORTEX 任务池的状态。
Queue a manifest-based task in my local CORTEX pool from DSH Web.
CORTEX 任务池的处理要怎么从 DSH 命令里恢复？
cortex-dsh-web-command 的功能「任务池命令」：在 DSH Web 输入 /cortex status、recover 或 enqueue 子命令，查询任务状态、请求恢复或提交 manifest 任务，并返回简短结果。
cortex-dsh-web-command 使用前须知：需要配置 CORTEX_API_TOKEN，并将命令请求发送到本机 loopback CORTEX API；默认地址是 127.0.0.1:8787。

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Cortex Harness：Cortex Harness is the open protocol and reference tooling for running CORTEX
work as small Blocks. A Block has its own entrypoint, tests, and public
contract. The CORTEX Kernel remains the authority for leases, replay,
receipts, and completion decisions.

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Cortex Harness：The public constitution is the CORTEX Six Laws, also called the CORTEX
Collaboration Constitution. English is the source language for the engine

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Quickstart：Install Node.js 24 or newer. Cloning and testing does not need a CORTEX
server or a DSH install.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mobfish-ai/cortex-harness-open.git
cd cortex-harness-open
npm test
```

`npm test` runs the Node.js test runner, the export grep gate, and the CJK gate.

To send live commands, run a CORTEX task-pool server on loopback and install
the adapter into a local DSH Web profile. Keep the token in the host
environment:

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Quickstart：```sh
export CORTEX_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787
export CORTEX_API_TOKEN='token configured on your local task-pool server'
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:$PWD/packages/dsh-web-cortex-command"
dsh web

Then, in the chat input:

```text
/cortex status
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 1
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 3
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 5

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Quickstart：`CORTEX_API_BASE_URL` must use `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, or `::1`. The default
is `http://127.0.0.1:8787`. `manifest` is a relative path inside the manifest
root configured on that server. The adapter can inspect, enqueue, and recover.
Settlement and completion stay on the CORTEX side.

The registry name `cortex-dsh-web-command` is reserved for a later npm
release. No registry release is published from this repository yet.

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Blocks：`discovery-chain-index` is the first Block. It builds an index of a discovery
chain, the ordered record of what the harness found, so later blocks can read
that index.

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Blocks：That block is still under review and is not exported into this repository.
When the review finishes, it lands in [`blocks/`](blocks/) as
`blocks/discovery-chain-index`, with the entry script
`scripts/discovery-chain-index.mjs`. The candidate list, including the
`cortex-loop` self-improvement engine, is in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md).

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Reference adapter：[`packages/dsh-web-cortex-command`](packages/dsh-web-cortex-command/) is the
host-side DSH Web bridge that is already in the tree. The browser sends a
`/cortex` slash command and receives a short summary. The host process calls
`/v1/native-task-pool/{status,enqueue,recover}` on the loopback API with
`CORTEX_API_TOKEN`. Error text has the token replaced with `[redacted]`
before it returns.

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Reference adapter：```text
browser   slash command, no token     DSH host plugin (this repo)
host      Bearer token, loopback      CORTEX task-pool API
task pool                             CORTEX Kernel
```

The repository root `package.json` is the GitHub-installable bundle for that
plugin. Its `dsh.bundle.patch` field points at
`packages/dsh-web-cortex-command/cordis.patch.yml`.

The adapter is not an allowlisted class in [ALLOWLIST.md](ALLOWLIST.md). It
remains as a pre-allowlist export.

cortex-dsh-web-command README · 快速开始：安装 Node.js 24 或更新版本。克隆和测试不需要 CORTEX 服务器，也不需要安装 DSH。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mobfish-ai/cortex-harness-open.git
cd cortex-harness-open
npm test
```

`npm test` 会运行 Node.js 测试、导出 grep 门禁和 CJK 门禁。

要发送真实命令，在回环地址上运行 CORTEX 任务池服务器，并把适配器安装到本地 DSH Web 配置。令牌只放在宿主机环境里：

```sh
export CORTEX_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787
export CORTEX_API_TOKEN='token configured on your local task-pool server'
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:$PWD/packages/dsh-web-cortex-command"
dsh web

然后在聊天输入框中：

cortex-dsh-web-command README · 快速开始：```text
/cortex status
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 1
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 3
/cortex enqueue <task_id> <manifest> 5

`CORTEX_API_BASE_URL` 必须使用 `127.0.0.1`、`localhost` 或 `::1`。默认值是 `http://127.0.0.1:8787`。`manifest` 是该服务器上清单根目录内的相对路径。适配器可以查看、入队和恢复。结算和完成仍在 CORTEX 一侧。

注册名 `cortex-dsh-web-command` 留给以后的 npm 发布。本仓库目前不发布注册表版本。

cortex-dsh-web-command README · Block：`discovery-chain-index` 是第一个 Block。它为发现链建立索引。发现链是 harness 找到的内容的有序记录，供后面的 Block 读取。

该 Block 仍在评审中，还没有导出到本仓库。评审结束后，它会落到 [`blocks/`](blocks/) 的 `blocks/discovery-chain-index`，入口脚本是 `scripts/discovery-chain-index.mjs`。候选名单，包括 `cortex-loop` 自改进引擎，写在 [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md)。

cortex-dsh-web-command README · 参考适配器：[`packages/dsh-web-cortex-command`](packages/dsh-web-cortex-command/) 是已经在树里的宿主机侧 DSH Web 桥。浏览器发送 `/cortex` 斜杠命令并收到一段短摘要。宿主机进程用 `CORTEX_API_TOKEN` 调用回环 API 的 `/v1/native-task-pool/{status,enqueue,recover}`。错误文本在返回前把令牌替换成 `[redacted]`。

```text
browser   slash command, no token     DSH host plugin (this repo)
host      Bearer token, loopback      CORTEX task-pool API
task pool                             CORTEX Kernel
```

cortex-dsh-web-command README · 参考适配器：仓库根目录的 `package.json` 是这个插件的 GitHub 可安装包。它的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 字段指向 `packages/dsh-web-cortex-command/cordis.patch.yml`。

该适配器不是 [ALLOWLIST.md](ALLOWLIST.md) 里的允许类别。它作为允许清单出现之前的导出保留在树里。
